items.name: file-field-ui
items.title: NocoBase Files Field UI
items.description: Application-owned upload, list, thumbnail, and preview components for business file endpoints.
items.docs: Install this item when an application needs editable file UI. Pass a FilesClient created for the consuming business endpoint; the installed source owns its layout and behavior. It does not add a route or server-side implementation. Review plugin upgrades with a three-way merge because installed files are application-owned.

items.name: demo-page-ui
items.title: NocoBase Files Demo Page UI
items.description: Application-owned Demo page for the plugin's real attachments API.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/app-plugin-files to be enabled. The page calls GET /api/attachments/examples, then uses the returned endpoints for the Profile Avatar and Order Attachments clients. Its extension overrides the existing files Demo route component and does not declare another /files-demo route. The installed source is application-owned, is not overwritten by plugin upgrades, and should be reviewed with a three-way merge.
